highlights: Yesido EC33 Multi-Functional Fridge Deodorizer / Odor Eliminator / Sterilizer
Multi-scene deodorizer suitable for refrigerators, shoe cabinets, wardrobes, pet areas, bathrooms, and other enclosed spaces
Three working modes: Mild Deodorization, Deep Deodorization, and Sterilization
Battery life: up to 25 days in mild mode
Digital LED display showing working status and battery level
Compact portable design for easy placement
